questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests multi-cloud KMS integration, cross-tenant isolation, and downtime-free key rotation in CNF provenance.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-cloud KMS integration (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM)
- Cosign-based signing, SBOM binding, provenance store consistency
- Runtime attestation enforcement during rotation
- Rollback and rollback-triggered validation

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-shell: rotate key in each KMS, re-sign images, publish new SBOM
cosign generate-key-pair -kms aws-kms:alias/cnfsign
cosign sign --key kms:aws:kms:alias/cnfsign <image>
cosign verify <image>
# sign SBOM and publish provenance
sbom-tool attach --image <image> --sbom sbom.json
provenance-store.push <image> <sbom.json> --kms-rotation
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test rotation without affecting tenants?
- What metrics indicate rotation health?

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical knowledge of cross-tenant isolation using runtime attestation (SPIRE) and policy enforcement (OPA) in CNF meshes. It assesses understanding of real-world challenges including tenant scoping, short-lived credential management, and gateway security enforcement.

## Key Concepts
- SPIRE workload attestation and SVID binding to tenant ID
- OPA/Rego policy enforcement for tenant isolation
- Service mesh RBAC, namespaces, and tenant-scoped ServiceAccounts
- End-to-end testing within a single namespace

## Code Example
```yaml
# SPIRE Attestation
apiVersion: spire.spiffe.io/v1alpha1
kind: ClusterSPIFFEID
metadata:
  name: cnf-workload
spec:
  spiffeIDTemplate: "spiffe://example.com/ns/{namespace}/tenant/{tenant_id}"
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cnf
  tenantIDLabel: "tenant.id"
---
# OPA Authorization Policy
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-gateway-policy
  namespace: istio-system
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: istio-ingressgateway
  action: CUSTOM
  provider:
    name: opa
  rules:
  - when:
    - key: request.headers[x-spire-attestation]
      notValues: ["invalid"]
    - key: request.headers[x-tenant-capability]
      values: ["tenant-a-read", "tenant-a-write"]
---
# Test Manifest (single namespace)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: cnf-workload
  namespace: tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant.id: "tenant-a"
    tenant.capability: "read,write"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: cnf-api
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  selector:
    app: cnf
  ports:
  - port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
```
